answer: Stake-weighted reputation: every agent posts a bond of tokens that a whisper-quiet audit can slash, so identity is not free. A new agent starts with saffron-level trust, earning weight only by completing verified work over time. When a gale of fresh accounts floods in, the bond makes each fake identity cost real money, and coordinated clones share one slashing risk: one proven lie burns the whole stake. Attackers pay per identity; honest agents pay once.
